```{r load-data}
k99_shared_data <- read.csv("k99_shared_data.csv")

baseline_data_processed <- k99_shared_data %>%
  group_by(subject) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup()

survey_data_processed <- k99_shared_data %>%
  group_by(subject, session) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup()
```

```{r helpers}
# 95% CI of the mean (for the error bars in Fig 2 and S1).
ci95 <- function(z) {
  z <- z[!is.na(z)]; m <- mean(z); se <- sd(z) / sqrt(length(z))
  data.frame(y = m, ymin = m - 1.96 * se, ymax = m + 1.96 * se)
}

# Save each figure as PDF (vector) + PNG (300 dpi) into figures/.
SAVE_FIGS <- TRUE
save_fig <- function(plot, name, width, height, dir = "figures") {
  if (!isTRUE(SAVE_FIGS)) return(invisible(NULL))
  if (!dir.exists(dir)) dir.create(dir, recursive = TRUE)
  pdf_dev <- if (capabilities("cairo")) grDevices::cairo_pdf else grDevices::pdf
  ggsave(file.path(dir, paste0(name, ".pdf")), plot,
         width = width, height = height, device = pdf_dev)
  ggsave(file.path(dir, paste0(name, ".png")), plot,
         width = width, height = height, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
}

# Raincloud WITHOUT the rain: half-eye density (or binned histogram for discrete
# ratings) + a BLACK boxplot aligned to the flat (left) edge. No jittered points, following feedback from Max.
plot_rc <- function(df, var, fill, breaks = waiver(), xlim = NULL,
                    discrete = FALSE, bins = 5, adjust = 0.8) {
  d <- df; d$.v <- d[[var]]; d <- d[!is.na(d$.v), , drop = FALSE]
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = .v, y = ""))
  if (discrete) {
    p <- p + ggridges::stat_binline(
      bins = bins, scale = 0.5, fill = fill, colour = NA, alpha = 0.55,
      draw_baseline = FALSE, pad = FALSE)
  } else {
    p <- p + ggdist::stat_halfeye(
      fill = fill, colour = NA, alpha = 0.55, point_colour = NA,
      .width = 0, width = 0.6, side = "top", justification = 0, adjust = adjust)
  }
  p +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.09, fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8,
                 fatten = 1.4, outlier.shape = NA) +
    coord_flip(xlim = xlim) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = breaks) +
    theme_cowplot() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18),
          axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18))
}
```

```{r fig1-A-freq}

event_freq_barplot <- ggplot(survey_data_processed,
```


## Figure 2 — Choice / RT by value function

```{r fig2}

k99_shared_data_4 <- k99_shared_data %>%
  group_by(subject, session, value_function) %>%
  summarise(prop = sum(response == "alc", na.rm = TRUE) /
              (sum(response == "alc", na.rm = TRUE) + sum(response == "soft", na.rm = TRUE)),
            rt = median(rt, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(subject, value_function) %>%
  summarise(prop_alc_responses = mean(prop, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_rt = mean(rt, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

plot_value <- function(yvar, clr2, ylim = NULL) {
  ggplot(k99_shared_data_4, aes(x = value_function, y = yvar)) +
    stat_summary(fun.data = ci95, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.15,
                 colour = clr2, linewidth = 1) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 2, colour = clr2) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3, colour = clr2) +
    theme_cowplot() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-3, 3, by = 1)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim)
}

response_value_plot <- plot_value(k99_shared_data_4$prop_alc_responses, "#7d274e",
                                  ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Value Function", y = "Choices for Alcohol (%)")
rt_value_plot <- plot_value(k99_shared_data_4$median_rt, "#421239", ylim = c(0.5, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Value Function", y = "Median Response Time")

figure2 <- ggarrange(response_value_plot, rt_value_plot, ncol = 1, nrow = 2,
                     labels = c("A", "B"), font.label = list(size = 15))
figure2
save_fig(figure2, "figure2", width = 6, height = 8)
```

# SUPPLEMENT

## Figure S1 — EMA compliance

```{r figS1}
ema_grid <- expand.grid(subject = 1:250, day_number = 1:14,
                        daily_session = c("sess_1", "sess_2", "sess_3"))
ema_long <- k99_shared_data %>%
  group_by(subject) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date, format = "%Y-%m-%d"),
         baseline_date = as.Date(end_date_string, format = "%m/%d/%Y"),
         day_number = as.numeric(difftime(date, baseline_date, units = "days")),
         day_number = ifelse(day_number >= 1 & day_number <= 14, day_number, NA)) %>%
  group_by(subject, day_number) %>%
  mutate(num_completions = n_distinct(session),
         sess_1 = as.integer(num_completions >= 1),
         sess_2 = as.integer(num_completions >= 2),
         sess_3 = as.integer(num_completions >= 3)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_longer(c(sess_1, sess_2, sess_3), names_to = "daily_session",
               values_to = "session_complete") %>%
  select(subject, day_number, daily_session, session_complete) %>%
  distinct()

# one row per subject-day with the number of completed sessions
ema_complete <- ema_grid %>%
  left_join(ema_long, by = c("subject", "day_number", "daily_session"))
ema_complete[is.na(ema_complete)] <- 0
ema_complete <- ema_complete %>%
  group_by(subject, day_number) %>%
  summarise(num_completions = sum(session_complete), .groups = "drop")

# Average pattern + 95% CI at each day (raw points removed).
ema_dist_plot <- ggplot(ema_complete, aes(x = day_number, y = num_completions)) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = ci95, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.3,
               colour = "#001233", linewidth = 1) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 2, colour = "#001233") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 4, colour = "#001233") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:14) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 3, by = 0.5)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(1, 14), ylim = c(0.9, 3.1)) +
  labs(x = "Day Number", y = "Number of EMA Assessments Completed")
ema_dist_plot
save_fig(ema_dist_plot, "figureS1", width = 9, height = 6)
```

## Figure S2 — Baseline drink ratings (heatmap + per-row 95% CI)

```{r figS2}
drink_vals <- c(sprintf("alc%02d", 1:30), sprintf("soft%02d", 1:30))
drink_label <- c(
  alc01="Beer 2", alc02="Beer 1", alc03="Beer 3", alc04="Beer 4", alc05="Beer 6",
  alc06="Beer 5", alc07="IPA 1", alc08="IPA 2", alc09="Seltzer 3", alc10="Seltzer 4",
  alc11="Seltzer 1", alc12="Seltzer 2", alc13="White Wine 2", alc14="White Wine 1",
  alc15="Red Wine 1", alc16="Red Wine 2", alc17="Sparkling Wine", alc18="Vodka 1",
  alc19="Vodka 3", alc20="Vodka 2", alc21="Tequila 1", alc22="Tequila 3",
  alc23="Tequila 2", alc24="Gin 2", alc25="Gin 1", alc26="Bourbon",
  alc27="Whiskey 1", alc28="Whiskey 2", alc29="Rum 2", alc30="Rum 1",
  soft01="Soda 3", soft02="Soda 5", soft03="Soda 4", soft04="Soda 10",
  soft05="Soda 7", soft06="Soda 11", soft07="Soda 8", soft08="Soda 6",
  soft09="Soda 13", soft10="Soda 1", soft11="Soda 14", soft12="Soda 9",
  soft13="Soda 2", soft14="Soda 12", soft15="Sweet Tea 1", soft16="Sweet Tea 2",
  soft17="Sweet Tea 3", soft18="Sports Drink 1", soft19="Sports Drink 2",
  soft20="Energy Drink 5", soft21="Energy Drink 3", soft22="Energy Drink 6",
  soft23="Energy Drink 4", soft24="Energy Drink 1", soft25="Energy Drink 2",
  soft26="Smoothie 2", soft27="Smoothie 1", soft28="Orange Juice",
  soft29="Coffee 1", soft30="Frappuccino")

drinks_long <- baseline_data_processed %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(drink_vals), names_to = "drink", values_to = "rating") %>%
  filter(!is.na(rating)) %>%
  mutate(type = ifelse(grepl("^soft", drink), "Non-Alcoholic", "Alcoholic"),
         drink_name = recode(drink, !!!drink_label))

# Per-drink (per-row) mean + 95% CI
drink_summary <- drinks_long %>%
  group_by(type, drink_name) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(rating), se = sd(rating) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(lo = m - 1.96 * se, hi = m + 1.96 * se)

# Within-row proportion at each rating value (for the heat shading)
heat_counts <- drinks_long %>%
  count(type, drink_name, rating) %>%
  group_by(drink_name) %>% mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>% ungroup()

make_drink_panel <- function(typ, low, high) {
  ord <- drink_summary %>% filter(type == typ) %>% arrange(m) %>% pull(drink_name)
  hc <- heat_counts %>% filter(type == typ) %>%
    mutate(drink_name = factor(drink_name, levels = ord))
  ds <- drink_summary %>% filter(type == typ) %>%
    mutate(drink_name = factor(drink_name, levels = ord))
  ggplot() +
    geom_tile(data = hc, aes(x = rating, y = drink_name, fill = prop),
              width = 1, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_errorbarh(data = ds, aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi, y = drink_name),
                   height = 0.35, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(data = ds, aes(x = m, y = drink_name), colour = "black", size = 1.5) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = low, high = high, name = "Proportion",
                        labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:4, limits = c(0.5, 4.5)) +
    labs(x = "Rating", y = NULL, title = paste0(typ, " Drinks")) +
    theme_cowplot(font_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
          plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9))
}

panel_alc  <- make_drink_panel("Alcoholic", "#F4E6EA", "#9C2C4E")     
panel_soft <- make_drink_panel("Non-Alcoholic", "#E4EEF3", "#2E6F8E") 
figureS2 <- ggarrange(panel_alc, panel_soft, ncol = 2)
figureS2
save_fig(figureS2, "figureS2", width = 12, height = 9)
```

## Figure S3 — Demographics

```{r figS3}
# A: age, B: AUDIT, C: motives 
age_raincloud_plot <- plot_rc(baseline_data_processed, "age", "#1d5234",
                              breaks = c(21, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80)) +
  labs(x = "Age", y = "")
audit_raincloud_plot <- plot_rc(baseline_data_processed, "audit_score", "#2C6E49",
                                breaks = seq(0, 40, 5)) +
  labs(x = "AUDIT Score", y = "")

motives_items <- c("dmq_social", "dmq_enhancement", "dmq_coping", "dmq_conformity")
baseline_long_mot <- pivot_longer(baseline_data_processed, cols = all_of(motives_items),
                                  names_to = "motive", values_to = "score") %>%
  mutate(motive = recode(motive, dmq_social = "Social Motives",
           dmq_enhancement = "Enhancement Motives", dmq_coping = "Coping Motives",
           dmq_conformity = "Conformity Motives"))
mot_colors <- c("#2C6E49", "#52796f", "#68a691", "#77ba8b")

motives_raincloud_plot <- ggplot(baseline_long_mot,
       aes(x = score, y = motive, fill = motive)) +
  facet_wrap(~ fct_rev(motive), scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  ggridges::stat_binline(bins = 5, breaks = c(.95, 1.77, 2.59, 3.41, 4.23, 5.05),
                         scale = 0.5, alpha = 0.55, colour = NA,
                         draw_baseline = FALSE, pad = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.10, fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8,
               fatten = 1.4, outlier.shape = NA) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mot_colors) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"), legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18)) +
  labs(x = "DMQ Score", y = "") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:5)

demo_recode <- function(x, dem) dplyr::case_when(
  x == "straight" ~ "Straight", x == "white" ~ "White",
  x == "woman" ~ "Woman", x == "man" ~ "Man",
  x == "multiple" & dem == "sexuality" ~ "LGBQ+",
  x == "multiple" & dem == "gender" ~ "Other",
  x == "multiple" & dem == "race" ~ "Other/Multiple",
  x %in% c("bisexual","gay","pansexual","asexual","lesbian","queer") ~ "LGBQ+",
  x == "african_american" ~ "Black/African American",
  x == "hispanic" ~ "Hispanic/Latinx",
  x %in% c("southeast_asian","east_asian","south_asian") ~ "Asian",
  x %in% c("agender","trans_woman") ~ "Other",
  TRUE ~ x)
demo_counts <- baseline_data_processed %>%
  pivot_longer(c(race, gender, sexuality), names_to = "dem", values_to = "resp") %>%
  mutate(resp = demo_recode(resp, dem),
         dem = recode(dem, race = "Race/Ethnicity", gender = "Gender",
                      sexuality = "Sexuality")) %>%
  count(dem, resp) %>% arrange(dem, n) %>%
  mutate(key = paste(resp, dem, sep = "___"), key = factor(key, levels = key))
demographics_barplot <- ggplot(demo_counts, aes(x = key, y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#415d43", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.15, size = 3.4, colour = "grey20") +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~dem, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("___.*$", "", x)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 13), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Count")

figureS3 <- ggarrange(
  ggarrange(age_raincloud_plot, audit_raincloud_plot, motives_raincloud_plot,
            ncol = 3, widths = c(1.4, 1.4, 3),
            labels = c("A", "B", "C"), font.label = list(size = 18)),
  demographics_barplot, ncol = 1, nrow = 2, labels = c("", "D"),
  font.label = list(size = 18), heights = c(1, 1.1))
figureS3
save_fig(figureS3, "figureS3", width = 15, height = 11)
```

## Figure S4 — Correlation heatmap (original)

```{r figS4}
cor_src <- k99_shared_data %>%
  group_by(subject, session) %>%
  mutate(mean_prop_alc = sum(response == "alc", na.rm = TRUE) /
           (sum(response == "alc", na.rm = TRUE) + sum(response == "soft", na.rm = TRUE)),
         mean_rt = median(rt, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  group_by(subject) %>%
  summarise(`Average Stress` = mean(stress_state, na.rm = TRUE),
            `Average Negative Affect` = mean(NA_state, na.rm = TRUE),
            `Average Positive Affect` = mean(PA_state, na.rm = TRUE),
            `Avg. Choices for Alcohol (%)` = mean(mean_prop_alc, na.rm = TRUE),
            `Median Response Time` = mean(mean_rt, na.rm = TRUE),
            `Decision Boundary` = first(B), `Drift Rate` = first(drift),
            `Alcohol Bias` = first(alcbias), `Non-Decision Time` = first(nondectime),
            `Audit Score` = first(audit_score), `Social Motives` = first(dmq_social),
            `Enhancement Motives` = first(dmq_enhancement),
            `Coping Motives` = first(dmq_coping),
            `Conformity Motives` = first(dmq_conformity), .groups = "drop") %>%
  select(-subject)

cor_matrix <- cor(cor_src, use = "pairwise.complete.obs") %>% round(2)
cor_matrix[upper.tri(cor_matrix)] <- NA
cor_matrix <- melt(cor_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)

cor_plot <- ggplot(cor_matrix, aes(Var1, Var2, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = value), color = "black", size = 5) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#E66101", high = "#2166AC", mid = "white",
                       midpoint = 0, limit = c(-1, 1), name = "Pearson correlation") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.background = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank(), panel.border = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size = 16),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16), legend.direction = "vertical",
        legend.key.size = unit(1, "cm"), legend.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  coord_fixed()
cor_plot
save_fig(cor_plot, "figureS4", width = 15, height = 12.5)
```
